comparable_startups.name: Shopify
comparable_startups.description: E-commerce platform enabling merchant storefronts and payment systems.
comparable_startups.why_comparable: Shopify provides the infrastructure for individuals and businesses to sell goods online, similar to the core function of an 'app to sell clothes'. It highlights the importance of a robust, user-friendly platform for merchants.
comparable_startups.lessons_learned: Build an open ecosystem app store so third-party developers construct features you do not need to build.

comparable_startups.name: Airbnb
comparable_startups.description: Global peer-to-peer online marketplace for homestays and lodging.
comparable_startups.why_comparable: Airbnb is a successful marketplace connecting demand and supply (hosts and guests). An 'app to sell clothes' is also a marketplace, requiring similar solutions for trust, transactions, and user experience.
comparable_startups.business_model: Dual-sided booking service fees (host and guest percentages)
comparable_startups.lessons_learned: Solve double-sided trust issues through verified reviews, profiles, and institutional insurances.

comparable_startups.name: Upwork
comparable_startups.description: Freelance talent matching and remote project management platform.
comparable_startups.why_comparable: Upwork facilitates transactions and project management between independent parties. For an app selling clothes, this comparison highlights the need for integrated tools to manage listings, communication, and secure payments.
comparable_startups.business_model: Contractor transaction fees + client service charges
comparable_startups.lessons_learned: Embed collaboration and payment escrow systems within the marketplace to lock in user activity.

comparable_startups.name: Instacart
comparable_startups.description: On-demand grocery delivery connecting local shoppers with retail partners.
comparable_startups.why_comparable: Instacart operates as a marketplace for physical goods with a strong logistical component. While clothes selling might not have the same delivery urgency, the model of connecting consumers with available inventory (or sellers) is relevant.
comparable_startups.lessons_learned: Build asset-light operations by outsourcing delivery logistics to independent contractors.
